content:
Apple has this week added a new batch of products to its official Certified Refurbished Store, including brand-new M5 MacBook Pro models, Studio Display XDR, and high-end M5 MacBook Air configurations.

Just a reminder: Apple's Certified Refurbished Store is a great way to save money, with discounts of up to 15%, and since you're buying directly from Apple's official website, you can buy with confidence.

Here's how Apple describes its refurbished store:

  • Quality products at attractive prices
  • Undergo a strict refurbishment process before being sold
  • Backed by Apple's one-year limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple's 14-day return policy
  • Optional AppleCare service plan available for purchase
  • Engraving and gift wrapping services are not available for refurbished products

One thing to keep in mind: we track every new addition and price drop in Apple's Certified Refurbished Store — stock moves fast. One of the purposes of this article is to let you know what's available, so you can act quickly before items sell out.

What's new this time at Apple's refurbished store?

New Mac computers

Apple has expanded the range of Mac configurations available in its refurbished store. These models went on sale earlier this year, and more stock has been added this week.

The most eye-catching among them is the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 512GB of storage, priced at US$1,439. Apple no longer sells this configuration, and even the entry-level M5 model now starts at US$1,999 with 1TB of storage.

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air, with 4TB of storage and 24GB of memory — Midnight: US$2,969 (original price US$3,499)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro, with 512GB of storage and 16GB of memory — Space Black: US$1,439
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro, with nano-texture display, 2TB of storage and 24GB of memory — Space Black: US$2,419 (original price US$2,849)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro, with 4TB of storage and 24GB of memory — Silver: US$3,819 (original price US$4,499)

Apple TV 4K

Apple TV 4K has always been a hot item in Apple's Certified Refurbished Store, and it's back in stock this week.

  • Apple TV 4K 64GB (3rd generation) Wi-Fi: US$169 (original price US$199)
  • Apple TV 4K 128GB (3rd generation) Wi-Fi + Ethernet: US$209 (original price US$249)

Studio Display

  • Refurbished Studio Display XDR — Standard Glass — VESA Mount Adapter: US$2,459 (original price US$2,899)
  • Refurbished Studio Display XDR — nano-texture Glass — VESA Mount Adapter: US$2,719 (original price US$3,199)
  • Refurbished Studio Display XDR — Standard Glass — Tilt and Height-Adjustable Stand: US$2,799 (original price US$3,299)
  • Refurbished Studio Display XDR — nano-texture Glass — Tilt and Height-Adjustable Stand: US$3,059 (original price US$3,599)

More recommendations

Finally, Apple has also added several new Apple Watch configurations and more to its refurbished store this week:

  • Apple Watch SE 3 GPS + Cellular, 40mm Starlight: US$249 (original price US$299)
  • Apple Watch SE GPS + Cellular, 44mm Silver: US$239 (original price US$279)
  • Apple Watch SE 3 GPS + Cellular, 44mm Midnight: US$279 (original price US$329)
  • iPhone 16 Pro 512GB — Desert Titanium (Unlocked): US$1,019 (original price US$1,199)

You can follow 9to5Toys for all the latest Apple deals throughout the week.
